note: Each row is one curve: coverage(s) = mean(errors <= z * s * base) with base = sqrt(sigma^2+var_op) (INFL) or sigma (TEMP), arrays cast float16->float64 exactly as the source scripts did. dev_joint_15cell = mean of per-cell coverages over all 15 iris_f4 fold-seed cells, multiply order (z*s)*base per t1_freeze_temperature.py; dev_lofo_holdfold_k = mean over the 12 cells with fold != k, order z*(s*base) per f4_uq.py; heldout_pooled = pooled mean over all entries of heldout_k32.npz, order z*(s*base) per t1_heldout_uq.py. z: 0.50->0.6744897501960817, 0.80->1.2815515655446004, 0.90->1.6448536269514722 (pf_common.py). 111 grid points per curve; s_grid rounded to 2dp for readability (raw grid = np.arange(0.5, 6.0+1e-9, 0.05)). first_s_reaching_080 on the 0.80 rows reproduces the frozen scalars and the five per-fold picks; verification in pooled_check.
